name: copy-buttons
description: One-click copy buttons on each code block and table, and at the end of every final answer: the reply as markdown or rendered, code, and tables as markdown, spreadsheet rows or boxed.

icon.title: Icon style
icon.description: The icon before each copy button. standard: ⧉, in any font. nerd-font: 󰆏, which needs a Nerd Font; pick it only if this icon shows here.

replyFormat.title: Default Reply copy format
replyFormat.description: What Reply copies on its first click. markdown: the reply as Claude wrote it. rendered: as the terminal shows it, without its line wrapping. Clicking again while it shows ✓ copies the other.

blockButtons.title: Code & table buttons
blockButtons.description: When a code block's or table's copy buttons show, at its top right. hover: while the pointer is over it. always: all the time, except one that would cover text in a narrow window. end-of-answer: never on the block; its button stays at the end of the answer (for a terminal that reports no pointer motion).
